_comment: Composed classroom setup: FinancialLibrary (curated explainers) + FRED + SEC EDGAR + IMF (live official data). Replace the placeholders: the path to your checkout, YOUR OWN free FRED API key (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/api_key.html), and your name + email for the SEC EDGAR user agent. Never commit a real key. The FRED and EDGAR servers are AGPL-3.0 — run them unmodified, as here. FRED tools: fred_browse, fred_search, fred_get_series. EDGAR user-agent form matches the upstream README: Name (email). IMF is pinned to commit 316fcb14c33fc15afd54f6620a6a240143ef5d35 (v0.2.0, data.imf.org). MIT alternative for FRED: pip install fred-mcp-server from https://github.com/floriancaro/fred-mcp-server (33 tools; Docker image ghcr.io/floriancaro/fred-mcp-server). See ../ECOSYSTEM.md.
